# Knowledge package transport fixture

Generated by AnswerPackage from a temporary synthetic library. Not live API output and not scientific evidence. HTTP/MCP and update execution are not activated by these files.

package-ref.json hashes the exact manifest.raw.json bytes. The manifest identifies QA/page raw artifacts and their full SHA-256/decoded sizes. *.chunk.json uses base64 transport, eof=true/next_offset=null. The source reference is an intentionally non-operational fixture ID; this directory does not provide an A1 source service.

Consumer can independently validate manifest→QA/page identity/hash/chunk contracts. Whole composite-job/resume HTTP fixtures follow after API implementation.
